decisions.rationale: 'spinocerebellar ataxia type 3' names one specific disease (SCA3) with no further subcategorization, and it appears in the title as the disease context.
decisions.guideline_section: What to Annotate 1 - Specific Disease mentions

decisions.rationale: 'Machado-Joseph disease' is a named specific disease that can be linked to one definition.
decisions.guideline_section: What to Annotate 1 - Specific Disease mentions

decisions.rationale: 'MJD' is the abbreviation of Machado-Joseph disease, introduced in the same sentence, so it is a separate synonymous mention of the same specific disease.
decisions.guideline_section: What to Annotate 6 - Synonymous mentions and abbreviations

decisions.rationale: 'neurodegenerative disorders' refers to a group of clinically and genetically heterogeneous diseases, i.e., a family of multiple specific diseases.
decisions.guideline_section: What to Annotate 1 - Disease Class mentions

decisions.rationale: 'progressive cerebellar ataxia' describes a clinical disease category that encompasses multiple specific forms (such as the SCA subtypes), so it is a family of diseases rather than one specific disease.
decisions.guideline_section: What to Annotate 1 - Disease Class mentions; grey-area terms example 11

decisions.rationale: 'disease-causing' is a generic descriptive adjective modifying 'mutation' and is not a disease name; the general term 'disease' is excluded.
decisions.guideline_section: What NOT to Annotate 4 - General terms

decisions.rationale: 'MJD1' is a gene symbol naming the gene ('MJD1 gene'), not a disease mention.
decisions.guideline_section: What to Annotate 1 - only disease name mentions are annotated; gene identifiers are excluded

decisions.rationale: 'autosomal dominant spinocerebellar ataxia type 3' is the most specific full name of the SCA3 disease, so the whole phrase is preferred over substrings.
decisions.guideline_section: What to Annotate 5 - Minimum necessary span of text; What to Annotate 1

decisions.rationale: 'SCA3' is the abbreviation of spinocerebellar ataxia type 3 used as a disease name here ('autosomal dominant spinocerebellar ataxia type 3 (SCA3)'), so it is a separate synonymous mention.
decisions.guideline_section: What to Annotate 6 - Synonymous mentions and abbreviations

decisions.rationale: 'MJD1' here refers to the MJD1 gene ('the MJD1 / SCA3 gene'), not to the disease, so it is not a disease mention.

decisions.rationale: 'SCA3' here refers to the SCA3 gene ('the MJD1 / SCA3 gene' and cloned homologue), not to the disease itself.
